Rumours that fares will double, which have been spreading actively on social media in recent days, have no documentary confirmation. The newsroom checked the register of executive committee decisions and the agendas of the next city council sessions: the question of public transport fares is not on them. Transport economics experts note that a sudden twofold fare increase is practically impossible without first calculating an economically justified fare and publishing it. Similar messages appeared last autumn as well, but they were not confirmed then either. Analysts who study the spread of false information point to the typical signs of such posts: a reference to an anonymous source, calls to share the post urgently, emotional wording and the absence of any documents. Readers are advised to check information on the city council's official website or to call the transport department's hotline. The newsroom will keep following the situation and will update this article if new official decisions appear.
